summary: The copied self-model read a substantially impaired skin sensor as almost fully functioning. Averaging across the body hid that local error.
decision: Integrate the repaired local readout on a copy, then test continued learning with actual sensor-function changes before predicting and choosing recovery movements.

measurement.text: Observed local function index: 0.326; predicted: 0.998. For skin, 0 means minimum configured precision (2 bits), not no sensation, and 1 means original precision. This observed value maps to 9-bit pressure/shear precision. Motor availability uses a separate force-gain fraction.

review_notes: Development scenes only, not a fresh-world claim or a measure of current live behavior.
120 isolated present-state updates retained optimizer moments but used zero weight decay and excluded other native losses.
The focused-site variant worsened whole-body mean absolute error to approximately 19 percentage points. This does not prove loss weighting is the sole cause.
The original diagnostic legend saying 0 means none available was imprecise for skin. The physical implementation retains a minimum 2-bit pressure/shear signal. Numeric measurements are unchanged.
